interpretation: Landsat ST is a skin temperature. It follows the seasonal cycle but exaggerates its amplitude (too warm in the hot-season scenes, too cool in winter); do not use it as an accurate water temperature (e.g. for DO saturation).
note: Sensor coordinates are those of the nearest CPCB stations (assumption); the in-situ value is the median of plausible readings between 09:00 and 14:00 local time.
